Dismiss [图标][图标] Get API key Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 [图标] Copy page Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 (gemini-nano-banana-2.1) is the latest high-efficiency image generation and conversational editing model. An update to Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image), it maintains Flash-level speed and cost efficiency while delivering significant improvements in visual quality, prompt adherence, multi-turn character consistency, and text rendering. It serves as the more efficient counterpart to Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro). Key updates: Improved visual quality and realism across 1K, 2K, and 4K output resolutions (default 1K) Fixed tiling artifacts on wide and panoramic aspect ratios (1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1) at 2K and 4K resolutions Enhanced text rendering and infographic layout accuracy Multi-image fusion supporting up to 14 reference images (character consistency for up to 4 characters and object fidelity for up to 10 objects) Grounding with Google Web and Image Search Configurable Thinking levels (minimal, medium default, and high) Try in Google AI Studio Documentation [图标] Visit the Image generation page for full coverage of features and capabilities. gemini-nano-banana-2.1 [图标] Property Description [图标]Model code gemini-nano-banana-2.1 [图标]Supported data types Inputs Text, Image, Video, and PDF Output Image and Text [图标]Token limits [*] Input token limit 131,072 Output token limit 32,768 [图标]Capabilities Audio generation Not supported Batch API Supported Caching Not supported Code execution Not supported File search Not supported Flex inference Not supported Function calling Not supported Grounding with Google Maps Not supported Image generation Supported Live API Not supported Priority inference Not supported Search grounding Supported Structured outputs Not supported Thinking Supported URL context Not supported [图标]Versions Read the model version patterns for more details.
